Confirmed no behavioural change: 24 hours of production edge logs show the only Data API traffic to any of the four tables is five HTTP 201 inserts into public.scanner_ai_ignores from a Supabase Edge Function on the service role. A successful insert against an RLS-enabled table with no policies is only possible by bypassing RLS, so the writer is service-role and this migration does not touch it. The other three tables saw no traffic.

An independent source-code scan of popcrm-web, popdam3, poppim-web, dflow_plm and apps/db-data-admin found every reference to these four tables is service-role; no browser anon or authenticated caller exists.
No shared database writes were performed from this session; production was read only.
